device.gpu: Apple Silicon integrated GPU; shared unified memory, no separate dedicated VRAM

memory_snapshot.note: Free is immediately unused memory. Inactive and speculative pages include reclaimable caches; these are not a single guaranteed available-memory value. CPU/GPU share the installed unified-memory pool.

scope: Observed current run. Ask times sum all recorded inference attempts; ingestion wall covers the whole ingest operation. CLI ru_maxrss is bytes on this macOS device. Model process RSS is sampled, summed and may double-count shared mappings; API allocation is a different measure. Not a formal speed benchmark or exact peak unified-memory pressure.
